metric_by_task.droid: recorded-action agreement score; not physical robot success

author_source.scope: Primary-source Tables 2, 11, and 12, CEM L2 rows. Maze is mapped to PointMaze. RoboCasa is outside this study and not included.
author_source.comparison_limit: Author aggregates use different checkpoints, populations, RNG and numerical settings from local runs. They are external context, not paired controls. Tables 2/11 and final-checkpoint Table 12 use different aggregation conventions.
author_source.uncertainty: Published parenthesized dispersion values are retained. The new readable chart plots the Table2/11 DINO/JEPA late-epoch SD exactly as reported, distinct from local episode SE. Table12 final-checkpoint across-seed dispersion remains in the source, not used as a late-epoch bar. Older all-arm figures remain point estimates.

development_source.kind: Historical author-supplied table, corroborated by local results/runbook; not a new raw-record audit
development_source.supplied_by: User history and explicit figure-task data, 2026-09-13
development_source.comparison_limit: Different scenario populations and planner RNG from fresh confirmation. Do not pool or subtract these native rates from fresh arms. Historical component MetaWorld results also used an amended device-equivalence gate.
development_source.component_native_note: Canonical historical native 44.79/30.21 is NOT the concurrent native for these MetaWorld component arms. Plots show descriptive absolute values, never component-minus-canonical-native effects.

fresh_source.scope: New protected scenarios, same-physical-GPU paired arms within each scenario. All eight arms are shown in protocol order, without ranking by outcome.
fresh_source.uncertainty: The readable benchmark shows local mean +/-1 Bernoulli episode SE:100*sqrt(p*(1-p)/96), not training-seed variation or a confidence interval. Paired comparisons still use the unchanged full48 simultaneous95 interval family. Older all-arm figures remain point estimates.

style_sources: User-provided Desktop/baseline.png: small-multiple vertical bars, zero baseline and direct numeric labels
https://stevenybuilder.github.io/pick-it-up/: restrained ink/green/blue/amber palette, whitespace, light chart rules
architecture_scope: Inference schematic for the six-block checkpoints used by this intervention study, not every architecture in the original paper. All base weights frozen during intervention. V visual input, A B3 condition, R B3 output; hooks at H3 within H6; no R+V/A arm.
